scope: Shared installer retry lifecycle and wrapped VRAM fills. Synthetic inputs and actual software OpenGL; no retail assets, game launch, installer window or hardware GPU.
pairing: Each targeted before/after pair used an identical prebuilt test DLL and unchanged source/project files. Only RecompOne.Runtime.dll was replaced. Fixture directories differ; their synthetic generator and contents are unchanged. The integrated gate later rebuilt normally.
selection_policy: PASS/FAIL assertion lines, GPU context lines, GPU summaries and timing/exit lines are selected verbatim in their original order. Disc summaries with temporary paths and setup/import chatter are omitted. Counts and exits are recorded separately. Raw-log hashes identify the original private execution logs.

limits: The installer test enters the actual private Session.Start through reflection. The outer EnsureInstalled ImGui pump is not run.
